# SimpleDex

Your quick reference for Pokemon.

## Overview

SimpleDex is a web application for browsing the original 151 Pokemon from the Kanto region. Search, filter, and explore Pokemon details including stats, abilities, evolutions, and encounter locations.

## Features

- Search & Filter: Find Pokemon by name or filter by type
- Detailed Stats: HP, attack, defense, speed, and abilities
- Evolution Chains: View evolution lines with sprites
- Locations: Discover where each Pokemon can be found
- Progressive Web App: Works offline after initial load

## Technology

- React with TanStack Router
- TailwindCSS for styling
- Convex for backend
- PokeAPI for Pokemon data
- PWA support

## Links

- Web App: https://simpledex.app
- API: PokeAPI (https://pokeapi.co)
- GitHub: https://github.com/anomalyco/simpledex
